---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new module, launcher feature, or improvement
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem does this solve?**
A clear description of the problem or gap this would address.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What should the feature do? Where would it live (launcher, in-game module, HUD widget, etc.)?

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought of and why you prefer this one.

**Additional context**
Screenshots, mockups, or examples from other clients/launchers are welcome.
